Wireline Contracts (aka GunFu Deathmatch) is a Tactical Survival Shooter which is in early access for now  with slowmotion and cloak of invisibility with lots of guns and customization. You can choose between 
Day and Night time maps and weapons to stay alive as long as possible, for now.
In the future we will add an open world map with storyline and side missions which you will able to play with your friends as Co-op, PVE, PVPVE, TDMvE and DM.

Dying Byte Survival will almost migrate to Wireline project. We building a base of the game on this project but which also will be released seperatly. Wireline Contracts are developed the way for Low-End Computers so its playable to any computer with GPUs above 1G VRAM and decent CPU above 4-Cores. 

You can download the demo to test it out with only 2 weapons and chooseble maps, or buy the Full Early Access Beta version with 7 choosable maps in day and night and 10 guns for now for low price which also will come on Steam when its ready.

This game is not at its final state and is not representing the final product.

Don't forget to Follow if you like the game and support us to bring a Persistent Open World Survival with all its features items and online gameplay.

notes.title: Devlog: "The Work in Progress"
notes.content:
Its been long time of development and get in touch with you people, so we decided to share some quick things we made. We have a demo thats not ready for you to play cause its unplayable. We of corse want to share that with you but its worthwhile to be patience and work it more further to its better stage.

We working on another project called [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Wireline/769406]Wireline GunFu Deathmatch[/url] (aka Wireline Contracts) which is low poly shooter that we will also release in the future on steam which we are prototyping here and will bring the base from it to Dying Byte and develop it as its befitting. 

What we can promise for now is a playable demo in closed stage map with enemy waves and its basic or more advanced features.

We share with you 15 images that we took from the prototype build (everything might change, edited and polished to its better version). Stay cool, stay touched we are coming we don't forgot you. Piece!
